rules.requirement: Runtime claims require observed telemetry; static reachability is never runtime evidence.
Simulations and forecasts remain PREDICTED until independently observed or validated.
Architecture claims exposed to models retain evidence source and reference.
Prefer repository-relative source paths, stable symbol IDs and source spans.
Reasoning and proposal operations never silently mutate, merge, push or deploy source.
Production-affecting changes require appropriate compiler, test, contract and security validation before promotion.
Compile bounded task-specific context and do not expose secrets or unrelated repository contents.
Self-evolution may learn and propose automatically, but production source promotion remains validation-gated and explicit.
Long-running or resumed reasoning must retain an architecture snapshot anchor and explicitly rebase when canonical architecture memory advances.
Provider/model identity may affect transport and context budgeting but cannot change architecture evidence classification or provenance.
